name: LG Electronics
h1: AX that connects the work end to end
lede: LG's AX agenda aims to integrate tasks and processes end to end, from the new AX Center to the NVIDIA cooling push. Airtable gives cross-functional teams the connected, structured workflows that AI agents can act on.
why_h2: Record results, a new AX Center and a fast-growing B2B pipeline
why_p: LG's 2026 pillars put AI transformation and B2B growth at the centre, and both cross team boundaries.

signals.title: NVIDIA Partner Network for power and cooling
signals.body: LG joined the NVIDIA Partner Network as a Power and Cooling Solution Preferred Partner, with its 2.6MW CDU qualified as NVIDIA DSX Ready and a 4.0MW model targeted by year end.
signals.angle: Qualifications, deployments and partner SLAs can sit in one tracker shared by engineering, sales and service.

signals.title: Record Q2 with B2B at 36 per cent
signals.body: LG posted Q2 2026 revenue of KRW 23.83 trillion and operating profit of KRW 1.58 trillion, both second-quarter records, with B2B revenue at KRW 6.50 trillion.
signals.angle: B2B growth brings longer, multi-team project cycles that benefit from one shared view of every account programme.

signals.title: Three pillars for 2026, with AX at the core
signals.body: CEO Lyu Jae-cheol set QCD fundamentals, a high-performance B2B and subscription portfolio, and AI transformation as the 2026 pillars.
signals.angle: AX integrates processes rather than optimising them one by one. Airtable is the layer where those handoffs connect.

signals.title: AX Center replaces DX and process innovation
signals.body: LG's 2026 reorganisation merged the DX Center and Business Process Innovation Division into the AX Center and created new engines for HVAC, webOS and robotics.
signals.angle: New centres need to prioritise which workflows connect first. A shared intake and roadmap base makes that visible.
